components.name: Primary Button

narrative.overview: A birthday gift designed as a personal film contact sheet — structured, tactile, and intimate. Memories are organized in clean frames with film-edge perforations, handwritten notes in the margins, and a ceremonial video screening box that opens like a gift. The system rejects random rotations and competing decorative tapes in favor of deliberate alignment, a restrained warm-paper palette, and purposeful accents that guide the eye through a three-chapter story: greeting → letter → gallery → film.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#fdf8f0) with subtle grain texture
Deep ink (#241e17) for primary text, softened for hierarchy
Three accent roles: rose (love/warmth), sage (growth/memory), gold (ceremony/climax)
Caveat for expressive headings, Patrick Hand for readable body copy
Film contact-sheet geometry: perforated edges, sprocket holes, frame numbers
Mobile-first intimacy: generous touch targets, readable type at default zoom

rules.name: The Three-Role Rule
rules.body: Each accent color owns one chapter and one interaction class: rose = Chapter 1 (letter) + primary actions; sage = Chapter 2 (gallery) + secondary actions; gold = Chapter 3 (video) + focus/climax. No accent crosses chapters.

rules.name: The No-Bounce Rule
rules.body: All transitions use cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94). No overshoot, no elastic easing. Physical paper doesn't bounce.

rules.name: The Film Frame Rule
rules.body: Every content container is a contact frame: 3px ink border, perforated top edge, left sprocket holes, frame number badge. Consistency builds the journal metaphor.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Caveat for anything that speaks in the giver's voice (headlines, prompts, CTAs). Patrick Hand for anything that speaks in the recipient's reading voice (body copy, captions, metadata). Never swap.

rules.name: The Clamp Rule
rules.body: All font sizes use fluid clamp() with viewport width. No fixed px sizes. The journal must read at phone, tablet, and desktop without horizontal scroll.

rules.name: The 8px Grid Rule
rules.body: Every spacing value is a multiple of 8px. No magic numbers.

rules.name: The Center Stack Rule
rules.body: Sections are flex-column centered. No sidebar layouts, no asymmetric two-column text/image splits. The contact frame is the hero; everything serves it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on the contact-frame component and modals — the two "lifted" surfaces in the system.

rules.name: The Backdrop Rule
rules.body: Modals use a dark semi-transparent backdrop (rgba(36,30,23,0.88)) with 10px blur. The journal page dims; the diary page brightens.

rules.name: The Perforation Rule
rules.body: Every contact frame has a top perforation strip and left sprocket holes. No exceptions. This is the visual DNA of the system.

rules.name: The Organic Modal Rule
rules.body: Only the modal card uses asymmetric organic radius. All other components use clean geometric radii. The modal is the "open book"; the frames are "film negatives."

dos: Do use the contact-frame component for every content container — hero, envelope, gallery items, screening box.
Do keep the three accent colors in their assigned chapters (rose→Ch1, sage→Ch2, gold→Ch3).
Do use Caveat for giver's voice, Patrick Hand for recipient's reading voice.
Do animate the envelope flap (rotateX) and screening lid (rotateX) — they are the two "physical" interactions.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable all animations, transitions, and scroll-behavior.
Do maintain 44px minimum touch targets on all interactive elements.
Do use fluid clamp() for all type sizes and key spacing.
donts: Don't add random rotations to frames — the contact sheet is aligned. The hero has one subtle rose tape (-1deg); the envelope has one subtle green tape (0.5deg). That's it.
Don't use bounce or elastic easing anywhere. The easing is cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) everywhere.
Don't nest contact frames inside each other. One frame per content unit.
Don't use the cream body background (#e8ddd4) as a card background — cards use --paper (#fdf8f0).
Don't add decorative repeating-gradient stripes outside the film perforations and tape edges.
Don't put borders on rounded elements that clash (the bookmark ribbon tip uses border-top on a pseudo-element positioned below the ribbon, not on the rounded ribbon itself).
Don't use more than three accent colors. The system has exactly three: rose, sage, gold.
Don't make the video section feel like an afterthought. The screening box with animated lid IS the climax — give it space (120px bottom padding on section).
